detail.command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p packages/shared/src packages/shared/__tests__

cat > package.json <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "msngr",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Client-server messenger (React Native / Expo + Node)",
  "workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"],
  "scripts": {
    "dev:server": "npm run dev -w @msngr/server",
    "dev:mobile": "npm run start -w @msngr/mobile",
    "build": "npm run build --workspaces --if-present",
    "build:server": "npm run build -w @msngr/server",
    "typecheck": "npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present",
    "lint": "npm run lint --workspaces --if-present",
    "test": "npm run test --workspaces --if-present",
    "start:server": "npm run start -w @msngr/server"
  },
  "engines": {"node": ">=20"},
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "^9.18.0",
    "eslint": "^9.18.0",
    "typescript": "^5.7.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.20.0"
  }
}
EOF

cat > tsconfig.base.json <<'EOF'
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true
  }
}
EOF

cat > .gitignore <<'EOF'
node_modules/
.data/
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
*.pem
*.key
.DS_Store
dist/
build/
.expo/
.expo-shared/
web-build/
*.tsbuildinfo
coverage/
.turbo/
.cache/
ios/Pods/
android/.gradle/
android/app/build/
*.jks
*.keystore
npm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
yarn-error.log*
.idea/
.vscode/
*.swp
EOF

cat > .npmrc <<'EOF'
engine-strict=true
EOF

cat > .editorconfig <<'EOF'
root = true

[*]
charset = utf-8
end_of_line = lf
insert_final_newline = true
indent_style = space
indent_size = 2
trim_trailing_whitespace = true

[*.md]
trim_trailing_whitespace = false
EOF

cat > .env.example <<'EOF'
PORT=3000
HOST=0.0.0.0
NODE_ENV=development
EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
EOF

cat > eslint.config.js <<'EOF'
import js from '@eslint/js';
import tseslint from 'typescript-eslint';

export default tseslint.config(
  {
    ignores: [
      '**/dist/**',
      '**/node_modules/**',
      '**/.expo/**',
      '**/coverage/**',
      'apps/mobile/index.js',
      'apps/mobile/babel.config.js',
      '**/jest.config.cjs',
    ],
  },
  js.configs.recommended,
  ...tseslint.configs.recommended,
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: { ecmaVersion: 'latest', sourceType: 'module' },
    },
    rules: {
      '@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars': [
        'error',
        { argsIgnorePattern: '^_', varsIgnorePattern: '^_' },
      ],
    },
  },
);
EOF

cat > packages/shared/package.json <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "@msngr/shared",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "main": "./dist/index.js",
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/index.js"
    }
  },
  "files": ["dist"],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json",
    "typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "lint": "eslint src --max-warnings=0",
    "test": "NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/jest": "^29.5.14",
    "jest": "^29.7.0",
    "ts-jest": "^29.2.5",
    "typescript": "^5.7.3"
  }
}
EOF

cat > packages/shared/tsconfig.json <<'EOF'
{
  "extends": "../../tsconfig.base.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "outDir": "dist",
    "rootDir": "src",
    "composite": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts"]
}
EOF

cat > packages/shared/jest.config.cjs <<'EOF'
/** @type {import('jest').Config} */
module.exports = {
  preset: 'ts-jest/presets/default-esm',
  testEnvironment: 'node',
  roots: ['<rootDir>/src', '<rootDir>/__tests__'],
  extensionsToTreatAsEsm: ['.ts'],
  moduleNameMapper: { '^(\\.{1,2}/.*)\\.js$': '$1' },
};
EOF

cat > packages/shared/src/index.ts <<'EOF'
/** Shared package placeholder — contracts/DTOs land here in a follow-up card. */
export const SHARED_PACKAGE = '@msngr/shared' as const;
export const API_PREFIX = '/api/v1' as const;
EOF

cat > packages/shared/__tests__/index.test.ts <<'EOF'
import { API_PREFIX, SHARED_PACKAGE } from '../src/index.js';

describe('@msngr/shared', () => {
  it('exports package identity', () => {
    expect(SHARED_PACKAGE).toBe('@msngr/shared');
  });
  it('exports API prefix', () => {
    expect(API_PREFIX).toBe('/api/v1');
  });
});
EOF

echo OK_ROOT_SHARED
ls package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js packages/shared/src/index.ts
